ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 35% high-intensity (white) to 65% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Dominant high-intensity white field with high-density, discrete dark-grey circular and irregular blobs (mottling). Right lobe: Dominant low-intensity black field with sparse, diffuse light-grey mottling concentrated at the inner proximal edge and distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression; approximate 45-degree angle transition between lobes, though the vertex pixel coordinates are partially occluded by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge; approximately 12-14 distinct peaks per lobe with irregular spacing and vertical pixel depth variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: S-shaped curve; convex curvature near the median notch transitioning to a concave sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density distribution of dark circular spots on the left lobe's white background; high-intensity, rough-textured clusters consistent with barnacle growth located on the extreme right distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Jagged, irregular margin on the far left distal tip indicating previous structural tissue loss; localized encrustations on the far right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry; the left lobe is predominantly white-based while the right lobe is predominantly black-based.
